story: It is our pleasure to bring the best of traditional Thai cuisine to the Pittsburgh region for both Dine in and Take Away. Nicky's Thai Kitchen is open at all three locations for lunch and dinner dine in and take-out as per hours below. Please note our dine-in service charge and tipping policy at this link which only applies to dine-in orders. You are welcome to bring your own Alcohol* Nicky's Thai Kitchen Downtown gets a private concept homepage, not a mailed pitch. The page keeps their name in the header, puts industry photography in a 4:5 frame, and makes the next step a call or their official site. Nothing here invents hours, a menu, an award, or a person who does not appear in a first-party photo. When.
storyMore: *Northside location corkage fee is $5 per bottle of wine and $1 per beer.
featureBody: *The Downtown and Mt. Nebo location both have a bar with a selection of wines, sakes, unique cocktails and beer, including the refreshing Singha Beer from Thailand. Corkage fee Downtown and at the Mt. Nebo Location is $15 per bottle of wine, $3 per beer.
